Commentary.Commentary: The South African bowlers on the other hand were very impressive. Paterson and Frylinck were the pick with the two finishing with combined figures of 8-0-42-4. Phehlukwayo was very economical. Ngidi and Shamsi did take some pounding but the two did take a few important wickets. The target is not a big one and with the small boundaries here, the hosts will fancy themselves to chase this down. Will South Africa seal the series or will Zimbabwe level it? Join us to find out.

An excellent bowling performance by South Africa there. They were asked to field and they will be the happier side heading into the break. It all started with the man making a come back in the team, Dane Paterson as he got rid of Mire in the second over itself. Masakadza did hit some meaty blows but he too fell after getting a start and then Zimbabwe were three down for not a lot in quick time. Taylor and Williams then tried to steady the ship but the former perished when he tried to step on the accelerator. Williams found the fence a few times but fell at the wrong time. However, his innings has given the Zimbabwe bowlers something to bowl at.
Bye! Slow ball outside off, Mavuta swings hard but cannot make contact. They scamper for a run as Quinton fails to hit the target. ZIMBABWE FINISH ON 132/7 after their 20 overs.
DROPPED! Full and outside off, Mavuta swings hard but gets a top edge to it. The ball flies towards mid-wicket where Klaasen settles under it but cannot hold onto it. Two runs taken by the batsmen.
Length on leg, reverse swept towards point. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Excellent ball! Follows Chisoro and yorks him outside off, the batsman can only hit it back to the bowler.
SIX! Expected the short ball and waits for it. When it arrives pulls it over the square leg boundary for a maximum. Short boundaries these!
Good connection but straight to the man. Short ball down leg, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single. They think of the second but Chisoro sends Mavuta back at the right time.

Innovation! full and outside off, Mavuta moves across and paddles it over the keeper's head. The ball doesn't go to the fence as the fine leg fielder mops it up.  They manage to come back for the second.
Good ball, length around off, Chisoro pushes the ball through covers to change ends.
On off, Mavuta punches the ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Brandon Mavuta walks out to the middle.

OUT! Moor holes out! Back of a length ball down leg, Moor gives room and looks to clear cow corner. His bat turns in his hand as the ball balloons towards deep mid-wicket. Miller there comes running in and takes a good catch. Big wicket at this stage as this guy could have made a difference in the remaining 11 balls.
Just short! Full and on off, Moor extends his arms and lofts it towards long off. JP there takes it on the bounce and Moor will retain the strike. 4-0-22-0 for Robbie in his comeback to the side.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on leg, TC looks to flick it away but gets hit on his thigh pad.
Couldn't find the gap. Full and on off, Chisoro drives it hard but straight to the man at covers. He is disappointed as he knew that was a boundary if it had passed that fielder.
FOUR! Nicely played! Looks for the yorker but fires in a low full toss. Chisoro paddles it fine and with fine leg up, that runs to the boundary. Nothing the fielding side can do about it.
Length ball outside off, driven to mid off, they pick up a quick single.
Robbie Frylinck is back.
Full and on off, Chisoro taps it in front of him. 7 runs and a wicket from it.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Tendai Chisoro strides out to the middle.

OUT! What a catch! De Kock took one blinder in the last match and holds onto one in this game again. Full and outside off, Chigumbura looks to go hard at this one. Gets a thick edge which flies to de Kock. The keeper moves to his right, stretches his right hand out and the ball stick in his glove.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark, but they will need more of this. Short ball again outside off, Elton makes room and smokes it over backward point for a flat six.
Length ball on off, cut to point. EC yet to get off the mark after 5 balls.
Short ball outside off,  the batsman has deliberately lofted it over the slip region. They pick up a single.
Lungi Ngidi is back into the attack.
Goes fuller on leg, flicked through mid-wicket. Just 4 runs and a wicket off it.
Back of a length ball from Paterson who bangs the deck hard. Another surprise for Chigumbura who gets a soft leading edge towards the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length on off, Catches Elton by surprise as he gets a leading edge which falls next to him.
Elton Chigumbura is the new man in.

OUT! Against the run of play! Paterson gets a wicket in his second ball of his first spell and now in the second ball of his second spell. Fuller in length, follows Williams, who tries to flick it to the on side. Cramps him for room and gets the leg stump to cart-wheel! A good innings of 41 from Williams comes to an end at the wrong time for Zimbabwe.
FOUR! Momentum change in the game! Zimbabwe on top! Full and outside off, Williams drives it through covers for a good looking boundary.
Dane Paterson is back on.
FOUR! 24 runs off the over! A big one for the visitors. Tossed up ball outside off, Moor goes for the booming drive but gets a fat outside edge which flies to the third man fence.
Comes in from round the wicket and changes the angle. Lands it on off, Williams looks to pull but can't connect. The ball goes to the off side as they change ends.
SIX! 3rd maximum of the over! And this one is the best of the lot. Another loopy ball from Shamsi on middle and leg, Sean slogs it over square leg and deposits it into the stands.
Wide. The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
SIX! They could have had him in the first ball but instead, he gets his second biggie of the over. Once again the one-hand swipe. Middles it this time and gets six more in that mid-wicket region.
Driven towards the mid off region.

SIX! DROPPED! Loopy ball on off, Williams goes for the slog sweep. His bottom hand comes off the bat as the ball sails towards cow corner. Rassie looks to take it with the reverse cup, covering some decent ground to his left but fails to hold on it. To rub salt to the wound, he tips it over the ropes for a maximum.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.
FOUR! This was coming, just one run in the over so far and they take on Robbie. Short ball on leg, Williams pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another change of length from Robbie. 4 different lengths from him so far. Moor taps this in front of him to the off side and hares to the other end.
Length on off, flicked for the mid-wicket fielder to collect. 3 dots in 3 balls.
Fuller this time and outside off, played with soft hands to the off side to rotate the strike.
Length ball on the pads of Williams who delicately glances it to short fine leg.
Robbie Frylinck is back on.
Defended off the back foot by Moor.
A short delivery which has been pulled away through square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total. Moor is off the mark.
Peter Moor is the new man in. He played an excellent innings in the last game. Can he do the same here? Zimbabwe would love for him to do so.

OUT! Bowled' em! Off goes the middle stump and Shamsi is pumped up. He needed this and it is surely a confidence boosting wicket. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Taylor goes for another sweep but fails to put bat on ball. Looks back to see the stumps uprooted.
Another swipe. This time through square leg for a brace.
Leg spin on off, swept through mid-wicket for one.
A very good over comes to an end along with an even better spell. Length outside off, Taylor looks to drive it but fails to connect. Phehlukwayo's figures read 4-0-15-0.
Slower short ball outside off, Brendan goes for the pull but connects with thin air.
Slower length ball around off, Taylor plays it with a straight bat. So far so good from Andile in his last over.
Short ball on middle and leg, pulled towards deep square leg for just one.
Another run through that vacant region. Turns his bat to the leg side and gets to the other end.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Wrong 'un to end the over. Floated ball on off, Taylor gets ahead and bunts it down.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Looks to revere sweep but can't make proper contact. The ball goes to the off side.

In the air... but safe. Just short of Robbie at long off. Wrong 'un around off, Taylor goes low and looks to slog this but gets an inside edge which flies high. Robbie runs in but it is well ahead of him. They cross.
Another loopy ball closer to the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Leg spinner around off, driven to covers.
Two dots to end! So only 7 from the over, despite it going for a biggie. On the pads, Williams tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Well saved! Full and outside off, the batsman strokes it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and saves a few runs.
Length again around off, Taylor plays it towards covers for a quick run. Good batting, a run after a maximum.

SIX! Straight as an arrow! Fifty up with a much-needed biggie. Slightly fuller foes Phehlukwayo and Taylor lofts it over the bowler's end. The connection is such that it goes all the way. Need a few more.
Hits the good length again, Taylor finds the man at covers. He scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman is well in.
Good length around off, Taylor guides it to point.
Works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run. A good start for Shamsi, a much-needed one for a bowler who is slightly under confidence at the moment.
Slightly shorter and outside off, it is cut to deep point and the batsmen change ends.
A high full toss but Williams does not take full toll of it. He flicks it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Brings the reverse sweep out but does not connect well. It goes to the man at point.
Taylor now strokes it to long on for another run.
Tosses it up on middle, Williams eases it down to long on for a run.
Tabrez Shamsi to roll his arm.
Good length and outside off, Williams plays it towards third man for another single. Single won't harm South Africa.
Back of a length again around off, it is guided to point. 2 dots in a row.
Back of a length around off, coming in with the angle, Williams keeps it out.
Fullish around off, Taylor strokes it through covers for a run.
Around off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run. This is what you will see now, the batsmen will look to play themselves in.
Length ball around off, Taylor keeps it out towards covers and takes a quick run. 5 and wicket from Frylinck's second and he has figures of 2-0-6-2.
Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss. Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish around off, Williams strokes it towards mid on for a run.
Sean Williams walks in next.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Third one down and Frylinck gets his second. Also back-to-back ducks for Musakanda. The bounce does him in there. RF bangs it around a length on off, Musakanda stands tall and swings hard but the ball takes a faint edge and goes into the mitts of de Kock. He takes it and appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Musakanda stands there in disbelief, not sure why. Maybe he felt he did not edge it. However, no reviews in this series and he has to take the long walk back.

Direct hit needed but the fielder misses! Taylor pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder there is quick to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been very close if he would have hit.

Back of a length around off, TM pushes it uppishly but well short of cover-point. Another good over, just 1 from it. 3 and a wicket form the last two and South Africa will be the happier of the side after the Powerplay as Zimbabwe are 34 for 2.
Beaten for the second time in a row! Another length ball around off, it shapes away just a touch. Musakanda plays inside the line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
BEATEN! Good delivery, some swing on offer there. Fuller in length and around off, it shapes away a touch. Musakanda goes after it but gets beaten.
Another shorter in length delivery, it skids off the surface. Musakanda goes for the pull but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length and it has been defended.
Tarisai Musakanda is the new batsman. Also, Andile Phehlukwayo will bowl for SA.

OUT! No better way could he have ended the over! The LED light flashes for the second time today. The dangerman, Hamilton Masakadza walks back. This was coming, wasn't it? The intent Zimbabwe have shown till now and with only two from the over, the big shot was around the corner. It does not come off and Frylinck gets his first. He bowls it a touch short and around middle, Hamilton dances down the track and swings hard. He misses to see the ball hit the leg pole. Masakadza walks back after getting a start and Zimbabwe are in a spot of bother.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total. It is really good over till now, can he end it well?

Not watching the ball here is Hamilton! He goes for the paddle again, maybe by taking his eyes off the ball. Misses to get hit high on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Straight on the helmet! Once again HM tries to be innovative as he goes for the paddle. He misses to get hit on the grille. He seems fine though.
Goes after him on the second ball by stepping down the track. Frylinck bangs it short and Masakadza punches it to mid off.
On a length and around off, kept out. Masakadza wants to have a look at the new bowler.
Robbie Frylinck into the attack.
Another dot! So ends the over brilliantly! Just 4 from it! Bangs it in short, surprises the batsman. Taylor goes for the pull but is beaten by pace.
Three dots! So a good comeback after being hit for a boundary. On a length and around off, it is stroked to mid off.
Tucks the batsman for room but bowling it on his body. Taylor works it to mid-wicket.
This was also hit really well but the fielder was found. Just ahead of a length, Taylor hits it hard but finds mid off.

FOUR! Things keep getting better for the visitors here! The slightest of width on offer and Taylor pounces on it. He smacks it through covers, beating the diving fielder and into the fence. Making full use of the first 6 here.
Around off, kept out.

FOUR! You bet, he can! Ends the over in style! 16 from it. Short and on middle, bounces just about at the right height for the batsman to put it away. He pulls it through square leg for another boundary. Masakadza looks in fine touch here. Zimbabwe off to a flier, despite losing one early.

SIX! Second in the over! Brings out the innovation this time as he goes for the paddle. Connects it well and it carries all the way, over the fine leg fence. 12 from the over so far. Can HM make it a 16 run or an 18 run over?
Play and a miss! Masakadza will feel he missed out on another boundary there. Short and outside off, Masakadza throws the kitchen sink at it but gets beaten.

SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one! WOW! Bring the bag of balls out as that is outside the park. Full and right in the zone, Masakadza tonks it over the long off fence. He also holds the pose for the cameras. First of the innings.
Hits the length again around off, HM tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. Two dots to begin.
Just ahead of a length around off, Masakadza pushes it to mid off.
A dot to end a successful over for South Africa. Full and on off, it is stroked to mid off.
Goes back to bowling length around off, Taylor defends it out.
FOUR! That went to the ropes like a tracer bullet! Off the mark in style is Taylor. Slightly straighter in line and Taylor makes Paterson pay. He flicks it through square leg and the ball races away.
On a length and outside off, Taylor wants a sighter as he makes a leave.
Brendan Taylor is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Paterson makes an impact straightaway! What a sight for the pacer. The off stump going for a walk. Early strike for South Africa. He spears it slightly fuller and outside off, it shapes back in. Mire tries to whack it across the line but misses to see his off stump get uprooted. He fails to make an impact on return to the team as he walks back cheaply.
Starts off right on the money around off, the batsman blocks it out.
Dane Paterson to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Slapped! Slightly short again and it sits up to be hit. Masakadza stands tall and hits it through covers for the first boundary for the innings. Spoils the over and makes it a good one for Zimbabwe.

In the air... but on the bounce to the fielder! Slightly short and outside off, Mire goes for the cut shot but he gets a thick outside edge which flies towards third man for a run. Mire is off the mark too.
WIDE! Too short and it bounces over the batsman's head. First extra of the innings.
Zimbabwe are underway! Hamilton steps down the track and also moves across his stumps. He gets a short ball and HM pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Best of the first three deliveries! On a length and around off, in the corridor of uncertainty. Masakadza defends it.
Once again the straightish line, it shapes in just a little bit. Masakadza works it to mid on.
Bangs it into the pitch, not very short though and angles it into the batter. Masakadza works it with the angle towards mid-wicket.

We are all set to get underway! The players make their way out to the middle. Hamilton Masakadza and Solomon Mire are the openers for Zimbabwe. Lungi Ngidi to start the proceedings for South Africa. Here we go...
Team news - As many as 4 changes for South Africa as Duminy, Klaasen, Frylinck and Paterson come in and Tahir, Dala, Cloete and Jonker go out. For Zimbabwe, Mire comes in for Chibhabha.
TOSS - Zimbabwe win the toss and elect to bat first!

Hello and welcome for the series decider between South Africa and Zimbabwe. In the first game, the visitors gave the Proteas a real run for their money. The batting, ironically, got them close and faltered at the same time. It needs a better showing, especially from the experience in the ranks. The bowling unit has been delivering so far and you can bank on them to do the same. South Africa, constrastingly, have done well, but will be without their star bowling Imran Tahir who's been rested. A lot will rest of Tabraiz Shamsi's shoulders in his absence. Should be a good contest this time out again, hopefully more thrilling than the previous one. Let's see how it unfolds...
